_note: Response to gap-closure item (raga contraindications). No reliable, source-backed contraindication data exists anywhere in this knowledge base for any raga. This file exists to hold that data WHEN a reliable source is found -- it does not itself supply contraindications. An empty contraindications list below means 'no validated contraindication has been established in this knowledge base,' NOT 'this raga is universally safe' -- see usage_constraint.

usage_constraint.statement: An empty or short contraindications array must never be interpreted or communicated as 'this raga has no known risks.' It means the available source material did not address the question. The correct default posture for the recommendation engine is caution, not permissiveness, when contraindication data is absent.
usage_constraint.can_influence_raga_recommendation: only in the negative direction (i.e. a populated, sourced contraindication can BLOCK a recommendation; an empty list cannot be used to APPROVE one on its own)

condition_flagged_ragas.reason: chakra_raga_bridge.json / raaga_therapeutic_indications data associates this raga with epilepsy treatment (traditional/practitioner source, ANAHAT Music Therapy Training material). This is NOT a validated contraindication -- it is the opposite direction (a claimed traditional indication FOR epilepsy) -- but any raga associated with a seizure-related condition should route through therapist review before being shown to a user who has disclosed epilepsy or seizure history (see structured/clinical_context_questions.json, CC-NEURO-01), out of caution, regardless of the traditional indication's direction.

all_other_ragas_in_knowledge_base.note: No specific contraindication data was found for any raga not listed in condition_flagged_ragas above. This is the 'insufficient evidence' default state for the remaining ~85 ragas in raga_metadata.json, not a statement that they are confirmed safe.

recommendation_engine_integration_note: The Raga Selection Rules / Safety Filtering step in the pipeline should treat this file as a BLOCK LIST candidate source (condition_flagged_ragas require clinical_context_questions.json disclosures to be checked before recommending), not an ALLOW LIST. Absence from this file is not evidence of safety.
